commands.review_summary:
The branch changes repository-size validation to inspect staged Git index blobs, expands shell regression coverage and docs, adds a changelog note, and raises macOS CI test timeouts.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main checks mutable working-tree paths from `git ls-files -z`, so a staged oversized blob can be missed after the working-tree file changes or disappears. I did not run the shell tests because this review must keep the checkout read-only.
commands.review_followup: - No automated repair is needed; maintainers need to decide whether to land the owner-authored automation hardening and CI timeout budget change.

target.title: fix: validate repository size from index blobs
target.body:
## Summary
- inspect tracked Git index blobs instead of mutable working-tree files
- reject oversized staged content even when the working copy changed or disappeared
- handle a fresh repository with an empty index without an unbound-array failure
- reject release/build artifacts across app, dSYM, xcarchive, xcresult, ipa, zip, delta, dmg, pkg, tar.gz, and tgz forms
- cover the exact 2 MiB boundary, empty indexes, submodule gitlinks, symlinks, staged deletions, and newline-containing paths
- keep one-suite macOS shard isolation while allowing Intel cold builds enough time to compile the full test target

Follow-up hardening for #1858. Preserves contributor credit in the changelog.

## Proof
- Exact head: `d70e367fd136eacadb510544c852854ddb7935e5`.
- `Scripts/test_repository_size.sh`: passed, including empty index and staged-vs-working-tree cases.
- `Scripts/check_repository_size.sh`: passed against the repository index.
- `shellcheck Scripts/check_repository_size.sh Scripts/test_repository_size.sh`: passed.
- `Scripts/test_ci_path_gate.sh`: passed.
- `make check`: all repository guards, documentation, locale, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint checks passed; zero lint violations.
- `make test`: all 46/46 shards passed on the implementation head; the exact-head CI run is authoritative for the timeout-only follow-up.
- Exact-head autoreview: clean, 0.90 correctness, no accepted/actionable findings.

The first Intel shard spent about 26 minutes compiling, passed 64 isolated suites, then hit the previous 35-minute step timeout without a test failure. The new 50-minute step / 60-minute job budgets preserve the existing per-suite timeout and isolation.

## Risk
Low. The change is isolated to repository-maintenance shell scripts, documentation, and CI time budgets; it does not alter the app or release artifacts.
